Bulletin No: 01 LRA/26/02/17/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 12.30 p.m. on 17 February 2026 valid for the period until 08.30 a.m. 18 February 2026
For Eastern & Uva provinces and Polonnaruwa, Matale, Nuwara-Eliya &
Hambanthota districts.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely
at some places in Eastern & Uva
provinces and Polonnaruwa, Matale,
Nuwara-Eliya & Hambanthota
districts.
Therefore, general public is advised
to take adequate precautions to
minimize damages caused by heavy
rain, strong winds and lightning
during thundershowers.
